scope: Cincinnati Music Hall on Elm Street after the 2016–2017 restoration, represented in February 2019. Includes Springer Auditorium, both brick exhibition wings and the towers and roof ranges.

originalReview.notes: The wider Elm Street view controls the tall central gable and twin pyramidal towers, lower wings, roof banding and pale stone courses.

originalReview.notes: The close oblique view controls the brick and sandstone bands, round and pointed arches, recesses, porch and side wing window pattern.
The 2009 first-party detail shows the red and dark pressed brick and pale carved sandstone musical motif. It informs trim detail only.

quallaSearch.notes: Used two same-day Warren LeMay photographs with independent Commons Flickr CC0 review, plus Wholtone’s own public-domain masonry detail. All three match the exact published Qualla bytes.
